data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English elements, 'ar' meaning 'eagle' or 'ruler' and 'dun' meaning 'hill' or 'valley'. This name signifies a leader or ruler who is strong and powerful, like an eagle soaring over a valley. The name Arundell carries the meaning “Ruler of the valley” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Arundell usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of the valley and live with faith, good character and purpose.
